修复/api/node/master/agents 404错误：
1. 根因：_dispatch_node_http_request中get_agents()缺少_mock_req参数导致TypeError，被外层except捕获返回502
2. 修复：L6106 get_agents()→get_agents(_mock_req)
3. 新增/agents/{id}/access(PUT)和/agents/{id}/stop(DELETE)子路由到_dispatch_node_http_request
4. 删除_dispatch末尾重复的/agents/{id}/stop路由
5. 文件：app.py L6106, L6124-6138(新增), L6251(删除重复)
6. commit: 0e479d7→3ba1ba1→a74a30f→71a4ce7
